name: minimax-bot-team
displayName: MiniMax Bot Team / MiniMax Bot 团队
description: 把 MiniMax Code 变成一支常驻的 Bot 团队：主 Bot 接单并调度，成员 Bot 在私聊里干活，群聊里 @ 某人就是派活；每个 Bot 有自己的身份文件、记忆与定时任务。 / Turn MiniMax Code into an always-on team of Bots: a chief Bot takes the work and hands it to the members, every Bot carries its own identity files, memory and schedules, and an @-mention in a group chat is how the work is handed over.
author: antianqi
exampleQueries: 帮我搭一支 Bot 团队：先问清我要做什么，再定角色，每个 Bot 的身份文件由你写好 / Set up a Bot team with me: find out what I need, pick the roles and write the identity files of every Bot
建一个群，让几个 Bot 一起干活，任务从主 Bot 派到成员 / Create a group where several Bots work together and the chief hands the work over
每天早上让一个 Bot 汇总行业动态发给我 / Have a Bot send me an industry digest every morning
